subject: Mythology
title: Bushido: The Samurai's Mythic Code
description: One-minute skill: Bushido: The Samurai's Mythic Code.

hook.text: Bushido is the samurai code of honor that valued death over dishonor and loyalty above personal survival.

buildup.text: It blended Shinto reverence for nature, Buddhist acceptance of death, and Confucian loyalty to authority.

discovery.text: Samurai were expected to master poetry, tea ceremony, and calligraphy alongside swordsmanship and archery.

twist.text: The romantic version of bushido was largely invented in the 1900s. Real samurai were often political and pragmatic.

climax.text: Bushido myths still influence Japanese business culture, sports psychology, and martial arts around the world.

punchline.text: The code that defined the samurai was written after they were gone.

quiz.question: When was the romantic version of bushido largely formalized?
options: During the height of the samurai era in the 1400s
In the 1900s, after the samurai class had been dissolved
In ancient times alongside the first Shinto texts
